candidates.title: Best Paper Award
candidates.description: For the paper "Sorting Out the Document Identifier Assignment Problem" — a technique to improve compression of web-search inverted indexes, awarded at the 29th ECIR.

candidates.title: Yahoo! Faculty Research and Engagement Program (FREP) Award
candidates.description: Recipient of the Yahoo! FREP 2011 award in the area of Computational Advertising, Machine Learning and Search & Web Mining, while at ISTI-CNR.

candidates.title: Test-of-Time Award
candidates.description: Awarded at ECIR 2018 (Grenoble) for an ECIR 2007 paper (the Document Identifier Assignment work) that demonstrated lasting impact on the IR field.

notes: Confirmed the target person (CS professor at Sapienza / ex-ISTI-CNR / ex-Yahoo / ex-Meta) — the journalist/RaiTV Fabrizio Silvestri (radiospeaker.it, academia.edu 'Event Management' profile) was filtered out. The Sapienza DIAG bio and the Nature npj-AI editors page both state he holds 'three best paper awards' plus the ECIR 2018 Test-of-Time Award, but I could only individually verify one Best Paper Award (ECIR 2007) from an institutional source (CNR news). The two additional Best Paper Awards are asserted on the DIAG/Sapienza faculty page (https://www.diag.uniroma1.it/users/fabrizio_silvestri) and repeated on the RSTLess lab site and Nature npj-AI editors page, but the specific conferences/papers/years are not named there, so they are not included as separate candidates — a human reviewer should ask Prof. Silvestri or consult his long-form CV (linked from https://sites.google.com/diag.uniroma1.it/fabriziosilvestri) to pin them down. Also noted: the SIGIR 2023 Best Paper Honorable Mention on ISTI-CNR's HPC lab page ('A Geometric Framework for Query Performance Prediction in Conversational Search', Faggioli/Ferro/Muntean/Perego/Tonellotto) does NOT include Fabrizio Silvestri as an author, so it was excluded. Web-search quota was exhausted before I could probe further candidate best-paper conferences (KDD/CIKM/WSDM/SIGIR years); recommend a follow-up pass.
